entries.title: La-Mulana
entries.definitive_edition: La-Mulana 2012 remake on Windows PC, with original freeware and Vita EX as optional secondary archive checks

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC / native PlayStation Vita secondary
emulation.notes: Use native PC for the main remake and original freeware checks; use Vita only for EX-specific content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC remake presentation, with secondary historical/EX coverage.

primary.why: The Windows PC remake is the best main route because it is the modern rebuilt version, includes the Hell Temple content that was DLC on WiiWare, adds revamped Time Attack, supports multiple languages and gamepads, and keeps PC capture/settings flexibility. For strict historical completeness, the 2005 freeware original has changed bosses/maps/puzzles, and La-Mulana EX adds a Monster Bestiary and gameplay tweaks, so those are secondary archive checks rather than full replays.
primary.how_to_play: Play the 2012 La-Mulana remake on Windows PC as the main run. If Sami wants full version-history coverage, sample the 2005 freeware original for its changed original layout/bosses/puzzles and La-Mulana EX on Vita for the bestiary/tweak layer.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original MSX-style version with bosses, rooms, puzzles, and other design elements changed in the later remake.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample or route the original freeware build after the remake if version-history completeness matters.
secondary.why: The remake is not a pure port; it has changed bosses, maps/rooms, puzzles, graphics, music, and engine.

secondary.exclusive_content: La-Mulana EX layer with Monster Bestiary and gameplay tweaks.
secondary.what_to_play: Use La-Mulana EX only for the bestiary/tweak layer, not for a full replay unless Sami wants the Vita route.
secondary.why: La-Mulana EX is the Vita version, with an added Monster Bestiary and tweaks.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remake changes enough boss/map/puzzle content that the original freeware version remains historically distinct; La-Mulana EX adds bestiary/tweak content but is not the main fidelity route.

entries.title: La-Mulana 2
entries.definitive_edition: La-Mulana 2 on Windows PC with The Tower of Oannes DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Tower of Oannes installed.

primary.version: Current PC release plus The Tower of Oannes DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because it covers the base game and the major Tower of Oannes DLC while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility. The later console bundle is convenient, but the DLC is publicly documented on the PC storefront route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy La-Mulana 2 on Steam for Windows PC and install La-Mulana 2 -The Tower of Oannes- before a complete run.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; console bundles are convenient but the Tower of Oannes DLC is the key completeness item.
